reuse.why: No shared category-selection function is introduced or used; setZero is rewritten into a fourth copy of the averages' hidden-filtering SQL instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: The template rule is added separately in five places (one JS check, four `goal_def IS NULL` SQL clauses) and the hidden/group-hidden SQL is now copied four times plus the JS check in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The changes stay in server/budget/actions.ts where the actions live, but the eligibility rule is scattered across each action's own query rather than held in one helper.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, their query and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Any further change to which categories month-wide actions skip must be repeated in every action's SQL and in copyPreviousMonth's JS check, in two different idioms.

disguised_duplication.where: the same skip rule is expressed as SQL WHERE clauses in setZero/set3/6/12MonthAvg and as JS early returns on goal_def/hidden in copyPreviousMonth

one_place.where: rule added per action in server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth (JS), setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg (SQL each)
